Description:
Simply put, I would like a spritesheet of a rhinoceros. I'm currently developing an open-world RPG based around animals (more info to come in the near future!), and I just need a 12-frame spritesheet of a rhino. It doesn't have to be anything super fancy or multicolored. A single hue sheet would work great.
Reference Images:
